comment: Single source for the round-10 Step 2+3 COMBINED PAIRED FLEET's pinned parameters (design: claude-reply-26cc773 sec.3; Joe chose Delta_plan = 0.14 in chat, 2026-10-30). Fleet: threshold teacher (code/step2/search_s3_thr.php, sha256 4a1936fe..., the Step 1 build, byte-identical) vs RAW v10 (the Gravy anchor policy served raw -- paired_driver_gravy.py --arm raw on the fleet tree's own search.php, the Stage 3 fleet's raw-arm configuration), Gravy mirror vs heuristic, instrument parameter 87 / draw trigger 62, SAME seed and SAME seat per pair. Seeds 26001-26061 x seats {1,2} x arms {teacher, raw} = 244 games, 122 pairs (61 seeds; the first block above the pilot's 25001-25050 -- freshness proven by enumeration in fixtures/fx_fleet_seeds.py against the completed USED_GAME_BLOCKS record). PRIMARY read: paired Delta at draw = 0, seed-clustered bootstrap CI, round-9 bands verbatim. STEP 2 CO-READ: L3 (W=50 CRN, production server, sec.14 label engine, tuple L3-W50+H) on ALL teacher-arm overturns; per-game gain in the pilot's registered direct form over the 122 teacher games; the registered two-sample bar vs Stage 3 (+0.0649, SE 0.0090); pilot games are NEVER pooled. teacher_tuple is byte-identical to the pilot's (settings_pilot.json) and to Stage 3's; label_tuple likewise. Life score: ONE definition, fleet_games_report.life_score, imported by fleet_read.py (the round-9 form: win -> 1; capped (winner 0) AND own life strictly greater -> 1; else 0; the draw flag plays no part).

coread.attribution_ratio_guard: ratio = co-read per-game gain / the fleet's paired Delta (primary, draw = 0), under the round-9 sec.4 guard (stage3_attr_analyze form): the plain numeric ratio prints ONLY when Delta > 0 AND its CI excludes 0; Delta <= 0 prints 'n/a (Delta <= 0)'; Delta > 0 with a CI including 0 prints 'unstable (Delta CI includes 0)' -- with Delta's CI printed beside the label in both guarded cases, and the JSON carrying ratio_to_delta: null + ratio_note. Fai gate references (87% and 101%) print as history beside the line, not as this run's result.
coread.classes: per-class co-reads (contested / newly_contested, boundary 0.97 on the live stat row's top prior) and z-band edges, the pilot's registered form
coread.decision_rule: STEP 2 GATE: PASS iff z = (gain_fleet - 0.0649) / sqrt(SE_fleet^2 + 0.0090^2) >= 1.645 (one-sided alpha 0.05), the pilot package's registered two-sample bar (settings_pilot.json read.sizing.form); gain_fleet and SE_fleet are the co-read's direct-form per-game gain over the fleet's teacher games and its analytic game-clustered SE
coread.gain_form: the pilot's registered direct form (pilot_read.py): cap-aligned world scores (1.0 iff outcome > 0 AND the world ended by turn 61, else 0), CRN-paired job diffs over worlds finished in both candidates, per-game totals summed over ALL completed teacher games (zero-job games contribute 0), gain = mean of per-game totals; bounds from ONE set of game-cluster bootstrap replicates (B = 10000, seed 20261020, the pilot's registered bootstrap, cross-checked against analyze_l3.cluster_bootstrap); lb = 5th percentile (one-sided 95%), ub = 95th percentile; SE = sd(per-game totals, ddof=1) / sqrt(n_games)
coread.population: completed teacher games (driver rows without 'invalid'); a teacher-timeout game contributes no jobs and is excluded from the co-read population, counted in the read; if the primary is INCONCLUSIVE the co-read still prints, flagged as under an inconclusive fleet
coread.stage3_gain_source: round-9 Stage 3 attribution per-game gain +0.0649 (stage3-report.md sec.4), SE 0.0090 as registered in the pilot package (step1-pilot-package.md sec.5)

sizing.delta_010_crosscheck: at Delta_plan = 0.10 the same arithmetic gives variance 0.31076 and n = 243.9 -> 244 pairs (claude-reply-26cc773 sec.3 prints 'about 246 pairs'; the difference is rounding in the z-sum and is immaterial -- Joe chose 0.14)
sizing.delta_plan_derivation: pilot L3 one-sided 95% lower bound 0.195 (step1-pilot-report.md) x Stage 3's observed Delta-to-gain ratio 0.73 = 0.14235, registered as 0.14 (claude-reply-26cc773 sec.3: deliberately conservative against the 0.27 the game outcomes suggest)
sizing.n_rule: n = variance_per_pair x ((z_alpha + z_beta) / Delta_plan)^2. Two-sided (z_alpha = 1.96): 0.30116 x (2.8016/0.14)^2 = 120.61 -> 121 pairs; the layout takes whole seeds x both seats, so 61 seeds = 122 pairs REGISTERED (the conservative figure; achieved power at 122 pairs, two-sided, = Phi(0.14/sqrt(0.30116/122) - 1.96) = Phi(0.858) ~= 0.805). One-sided (z_alpha = 1.645): 0.30116 x (2.4866/0.14)^2 = 95.0 -> 96 pairs -- the convention Claude's 'about 122' does NOT come from. Full arithmetic in fixtures/fx_fleet_sizing.py.
